result.reason: The redline appropriately extends access to affiliates and contractors and conforms the third-party access restriction. However, it does not provide an express transfer right to a successor, as required by both the preferred and fallback positions. It also permits revocation upon any expiration or termination rather than limiting termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach, and it does not address perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but the revocation formulation and unsupported cross-reference to transfers permitted elsewhere leave material ambiguity.
